purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Baringo North Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 150 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This is a large 4-page form (form sub-page 13/18) covering many small ECDE-center polling stations; the final row is explicitly labeled CONSTITUENCY TOTAL (rather than TOTAL) and uses the standard column order (Odinga, Ruto, Waihiga, Wajackoyah, Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots), unshaded but fully crisp and unambiguous in the full-page render at this DPI -- every digit in the row (50287, 923, 37635, 016, 056, 38630, 175) was individually legible with no compression or overlap. The automated green/gray-shading TOTAL-row locator found no distinctly shaded row on this page (this scan's CONSTITUENCY TOTAL row carries no shading), so the value was confirmed by direct visual read of the full page rather than an isolated crop. The PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt). The printed registered-voters total reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 denominator.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed with a separately rendered high-DPI crop of the same row (auto-located by green-shading pixel detection, scripts/p23/find_total_row.py). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.
